description: The signed-in couple's own guest list on Zola: record the RSVP answer of guests to events, for up to 25 households, when a guest answers by text, phone or in person. Get each guest_group_id, guest_group_version and guest_id from zola_search_my_guests, and each event_id from zola_list_my_wedding_events. The guest must be invited to the event. An answer can change again later. A meal goes with attending only, by the name of a meal option of the event: the meal_options of zola_list_my_wedding_events. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same changes and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Zola sends no message to the guest. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

changes.description: 1 entry for each household, at most 25

answers.description: 1 answer for each guest and event of this household

meal.description: The name of a meal option of the event, for attending only. Leave it out to keep the meal choice

rsvp.description: The answer of the guest to the event

version.description: guest_group_version from zola_search_my_guests. A change of the group after that read stops the preview

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same changes

name: zola_record_my_rsvp

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of RSVP answers on the guest list of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the guest list

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_record_my_rsvp with the same changes, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

record_count.description: The guest groups whose answers change

records.description: The guest groups with a change, in the order of the call

field.description: rsvp: the answer. meal: the meal choice

from.description: rsvp: attending, declined or no_answer, as the rsvp argument. meal: the name of the meal option. Null for no meal

removal.description: True when the answer leaves attending

name.description: The guests of the group, as the couple knows them

version.description: The version of the group as this call read it

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token records the answers. nothing_to_change: the guest list has these answers. done: recorded. draft_changed and record_changed: nothing changed, a new preview

title: Record My Guests' RSVPs
